2.multiplier_note: The straight product of the legs' prices. ⚠️ A sportsbook prices a same-game parlay BELOW this, because the legs are correlated — that discount is not in any price we store, so this is the MOST the slip can pay and the real one pays less.

sgp_meta.line_leg_priced_at: the props' own book, not the best book
sgp_meta.note: 1 game(s) on this card carry a rated leg and 14 carry a shoppable line row. ⛔ No combined chance is published for a same-game slip and no EV is either — the legs are correlated, so the product of their records would be a percentage asserting something false. The payout shown is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book will pay for a correlated slip. ⚠️ Sam's 1.8x floor is applied to that upper bound, which is sound in one direction only: a slip whose upper bound misses the floor can never reach it. The ceiling is deliberately NOT applied, because an upper bound above it may be inside it once the book discounts.

sgp_rule: Same-game parlays from this card's own rows, ordered by each slip's WEAKEST leg — that leg's own record at its exact line. ⛔ No combined chance is shown and no EV is: the legs are in one game, so multiplying their records would assert they are independent when they are not. The payout is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book pays for a correlated slip.
parlay_rule: Legs are in DIFFERENT GAMES and at the SAME BOOK. ⛔ Every number is the player's own record — nothing here is a model output, and the combined figure is those records multiplied, which assumes the games are unrelated.

single_day_rule: This board is 2026-09-17 only. Priced rows for another day are not shown here and neither are parlays that would cross days — a card dated one day and half-filled with the next is two facts under one label. Minimum 5, maximum 25; a day with no games is an empty board, and that is correct.
coverage: 78 priced football rows for 2026-09-17 across 1 board games; 25 shown.
calibration_warning: under-60 hit 41.3% against a claimed 47.7% (-6.4 pts, n=46); 60-70 hit 43.8% against a claimed 65.1% (-21.3 pts, n=32); 80-plus hit 46.4% against a claimed 85.8% (-39.4 pts, n=28). board_rule: Sorted by the player's own record at that exact line, highest first — the same order the MLB board uses. Rows with no record sit below every row that has one.
